newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open up 0.05 to 0.10.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open up 0.05 to 0.10.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 to 0.10 cent higher Monday as dealers expect to see some follow-through buying after Friday's close near session highs.
Friday, October sugar settled 0.12 cent higher at 11.28 cents a lb after trading from 11.29 to 11.16 cents. Second-position March ended up the same at 11.47 cents.
An estimated 13,010 lots changed hands Friday.
Technically, traders said October would face resistance at 11.40 cents, followed by 11.50 cents.

LIFFE white sugar futures stood higher on Monday, bolstered by commission house buying. At 0852 EDT/1252 GMT, LIFFE October was up $2.20 to $325.50, while the rest of the board was $1.70 to $2.20 firmer.
